purpose: DESIGN INPUT for the Defect-9 macro-mask fix. Defect-9 = run_class_backtest (corpus/class path) lacks the separate belt-and-suspenders macro-blackout MASK that run_backtest has. This tally cross-references corpus trade entry timestamps (emit-enabled engine, commit c948bcd per-trade entry_timestamp) against economic_calendar macro windows to (a) answer whether the mask's absence ever flipped a zero/nonzero verdict, and (b) size the mask's real empirical footprint. FACTS ONLY. No engine code changed; not committed.

data_scope.note: S3 futures parquet IS reachable headless (AWS creds in .env, exported for DuckDB). NOT a passthrough/no-data run. Decisive pair reproduced live below.
data_scope.engine: run_class_backtest via `python -m src.engine.backtester --config <cfg> --mode single` (production CLI, compiled_spec dispatch). Emit fields entry_timestamp/entry_idx present on class-path trade records (backtester.py ~L7330).
data_scope.arm: BASELINE (TF_ROLE_DEMOTION_MODE unset), TF_ALLOW_FIXED_1=true — same invocation as scripts/corpus-v3-reference-rederivation.py; measures whether/when the strategy TRADES, not P&L sizing.
data_scope.engine_sha_context: backtester.py content == d22ea4b (Defect-6 MCL reconciliation fix), the guard-fixed class path the reference re-derivation is pinned to.

macro_window_definition.windows_source_engine_actual: economic_calendar._events_for_type() — prefers synced authoritative economic_release_dates.json, falls back to STATIC_EVENTS. This is what a real mask would consume.
macro_window_definition.window_logic: engine _check_in_window: bar in window iff same ET calendar date AND abs(bar_minutes - event_minutes) <= 30. Entry timestamps are already tz-aware ET; used directly.

CALENDAR_COVERAGE_GAP_KEY_FINDING.engine_used_earliest: 2024-01-02 (auth JSON preferred). The mask the engine would actually build has ZERO events before 2024-01-02.
CALENDAR_COVERAGE_GAP_KEY_FINDING.consequence: The macro mask can ONLY suppress trades in the ~2024-01 -> 2026-07 slice of the corpus window. Any corpus trade in 2020-2023 is structurally UN-maskable (no calendar events exist there). This bounds the mask's maximum possible footprint and must be reflected in the mask spec — the mask is inert over ~3.5 of the ~6 corpus years.

DECISIVE_ANSWER.why_decisive: The SOLE 1-trade v2-traded pair (baseline_n_trades=1). Only a pair with trade_count small enough for a masked trade to zero it can flip zero/nonzero status. Every other traded pair has 249-3309 trades (mask-immune to a status flip). So Defect-9 materiality reduces to: is THIS one trade inside a macro window?
DECISIVE_ANSWER.parity: Matches reference re-derivation baseline_n_trades=1 exactly (emit is count-parity-clean).
reasons: Date 2020-06-01 precedes the EARLIEST calendar event in BOTH sources (STATIC_EVENTS earliest 2023-02-01; engine-used auth earliest 2024-01-02). No macro window exists on or near this date.

Independently, entry time-of-day 00:05 ET (overnight Globex) is far from every macro event time-of-day (08:30 / 10:00 / 14:00 ET); even a hypothetical same-date event would not catch a 00:05 entry at +/-30 min.
Checked all event types (FOMC/FOMC_MINUTES/CPI/NFP/EIA/GDP/PCE/ISM/PPI) at window=30: zero same-date events, zero window hits.
DECISIVE_ANSWER.verdict: CLEAN. The flip-risk sibling 75DJN5UVQnw_MES does NOT flip v2 1->0 under the macro mask. Defect-9's macro-mask absence never altered this pair's zero/nonzero (verdict) status. The Gate-3 reference N is NOT disturbed by the mask for this pair. Defect-9 is NOT verdict-variable at the decisive pair — the mask can be added as pure defense-in-depth without re-deriving the reference on its account.

materiality_summary.can_any_v2_traded_pair_flip_zero_nonzero: Only 75DJN5UVQnw_MES (1 trade) is structurally capable of a status flip, and it is CLEAN (trade outside all windows). All other 25 traded pairs have >=249 trades, so removing macro-window trades cannot zero them. => NO v2-traded pair flips zero/nonzero under the mask.
materiality_summary.defect9_class: Confirmed defense-in-depth / non-verdict-variable on this corpus+window, NOT Defect-5-class (verdict-variable) as feared. Consistent with the F4 trace's DECISIVE-CHECK precondition.
